what_results_support: GT mass/friction oracle improves hard_id assignment by 0.5828pp in the audited pilot.
Random-address assignment error improves by 0.8159pp, but one paired seed degrades.
The preregistered M1a KILL and cancellation of M1b were correct.
what_results_dont_support: IFB/system-ID effectiveness or superiority to full-history baselines.
Broad VLA, perception, long-horizon, recovery, OA-WAM x EvoScene, or real-robot claims.
suggested_claim_revision: In one oracle-state MuJoCo pilot, privileged mass/friction yields only +0.5828pp mean assignment gain and degrades one seed; the preregistered headroom gate fails. This rejects the current operationalization only.
confidence_scope: High only for the positive C1 rejection and stopping M1b.
